findings.title: G6 clustered analysis could count a failed response with a matching decision as correct
findings.evidence: Before this cycle, the analysis compared response.decision to the private expected decision without checking response.status. A read-only synthetic probe with status=provider_error and decision=MAINTAIN was accepted and would have produced a correct boolean. Missing status was also accepted. The design requires completed/timeout/provider_error/policy_violation/invalid to be recorded and requires failures to remain in the all-planned denominator.
findings.remediation: Require every response status to be one of the registered G6 statuses; require a known decision for completed rows; count a response as correct only when status is completed and its decision matches the private oracle. Keep all non-completed rows in the denominator and do not rewrite historical artifacts.
